openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): Not relocated (lead). In spring 2022 a Ministry of Education official said the university would be moved to a safer city, but the university decided to stay: life.pravda.com.ua, 2022-04-01, 'Університет Каразіна залишиться у рідному Харкові'; acting rector Tetyana Kaganovska (Apostrophe interview, undated) said the team decided Karazin University 'would remain in Kharkiv' and 'did not stop its educational process'. Campus heavily damaged: UP.Life (2022) 'Russian forces had destroyed most of the campus with artillery and aircraft'; The Scientist (2022) a March 2022 strike destroyed the economics department building. Classes resumed online in late March 2022. A 2025 telegraf.com.ua analysis says the university 'maintains its scientific weight despite the destruction'. The only relocation-type lead is the cpo.karazin.ua notice that postgraduate internship teaching would partly use an 'Ivano-Frankivsk campus' (apparent 2024); a Ukrainian search found no Karazin unit in Ivano-Frankivsk, so this is unconfirmed. Current in-person vs online arrangements for the medical programme in 2025/2026: not found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Front-line region: Kharkiv is repeatedly shelled; the campus was largely destroyed in 2022 (UP.Life, The Scientist) and teaching moved online in March 2022; current in-person clinical training for the medical programme is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion with Kharkiv National Medical University (KhNMU), already listed as kharkiv-national-medical-university: searches mixed in KhNMU items (e.g. gwaramedia.com 2025 'only 9 international students start first year at Kharkiv National Medical University'), and one search summary even garbled the two names together. Any profile must state they are separate institutions.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: English-medium evidence for the Master's in Medicine is dated 2022 (lists of foreign students studying in English; online programme and network agreement with Igbinedion University, Okada for displaced foreign students). No 2025/2026 lead confirms English-medium admission of foreign applicants to 222 Medicine.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Licence annex: the 'preparation of foreigners' column value for the 222 Medicine row is not legible in snippets; one 'Так' appears for another 222 row with incomplete context. Do not infer foreign-admission rights from this.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Two School of Medicine hosts appear (med.karazin.ua and medicine.karazin.ua) plus legacy old.karazin.ua; which is current is unknown.
